sandbox: throwaway private repository, deleted afterwards (or left if the token lacks delete_repo)

facts.finding: Issue body maximum is 65,536 Unicode code points (not UTF-16 units, not bytes).
facts.request: POST /repos/{r}/issues with body of 65536 and 65537 'a'; 65536 two-byte chars; 32768 and 32769 astral chars.
facts.response: 65536 chars: 201. 65537: 422 'body is too long (maximum is 65536 characters)'. 131072 bytes and 65538 UTF-16 units: 201.

facts.finding: Label name maximum is 50 characters; 51 is 422. Labels per issue and per repository were not exhausted (no limit observed in the runs; the per-issue 100 and per-repo limits stay unmeasured).
facts.request: POST /repos/{r}/labels with names of 50, 51 and 100 characters.
facts.response: 50: 201. 51 and 100: 422 'name is too long (maximum is 50 characters)'.

facts.finding: Title: the validation message says maximum 256 but the API accepts up to 1024 characters and rejects 1025+; code must not rely on either number and should clamp to 256.
Search index lag after creation was 3 s (HTML-comment token) and 11 s (visible token) in one run; text inside HTML comments is searchable. Never read your own write via search.
facts.request: POST issue with a unique visible token and a unique token inside an HTML comment, then poll GET /search/issues every 3 s.
facts.response: Both found; first hit at 3.1 s and 11.3 s after create.

facts.finding: UserContentEdit.diff holds the full revision text of the previous state, not a patch; edits are ordered newest first; edits 2 s apart were not coalesced; the original body is recorded as the last node. Edits by Apps were not testable with a user PAT.
facts.request: PATCH an issue body three times, then GraphQL repository.issue.userContentEdits(first:10){editedAt createdAt diff editor{login}}.
facts.response: Four nodes, newest first, each diff the full text; editor lognd on all.

facts.finding: Deleting a label emits an unlabeled event on each issue carrying it. Renaming a label emits no issue event and does not change issue updated_at.
facts.request: DELETE /repos/{r}/labels/dellab and PATCH new_name on renlab, then GET issue events and the issue.
facts.response: events: labeled, labeled, unlabeled(dellab); no event for the rename.

facts.finding: 150 consecutive issue PATCHes at about 70 per minute produced no 403 or 429. Whether edits count toward 80/min or 500/h is not proven; they did not trip either limit at that pace.
facts.request: 150 PATCH /repos/{r}/issues/{n} back to back (about 0.95 s each).

facts.finding: Bodies written through the API are stored byte for byte (CRLF, trailing spaces and tabs preserved). Web-editor normalization was not compared.
facts.request:
POST body 'a
b
c  
	d 
' then GET it back.

facts.finding: Label application is case-insensitive: applying 'mixedcase' attaches the existing 'MixedCase'; creating a duplicate differing only in case is 422 already_exists.
facts.request: POST label MixedCase, POST issue with labels ['mixedcase'], POST label mixedcase.

facts.finding: No public REST or GraphQL operation converts an issue to a discussion (mutation list has createDiscussion but no convert), so the status code could not be produced. Treat 404, 410 and 301 as gone or moved, per F6.
facts.request: GraphQL introspection of Mutation fields; GET of a nonexistent issue (404) recorded as the closest measurable case.

facts.finding: The issues edited payload carries changes.title.from and changes.body.from, but not reliably: a combined title and body PATCH delivered only changes.body, and a title-only PATCH delivered body.from as an empty string next to title.from. Treat changes.* as a hint only.
facts.request: Workflow on issues:[edited] printing toJSON(github.event.changes); PATCH title and body, then title only.
facts.response: changes.body.from only; then changes.body.from='' plus changes.title.from.

facts.finding: A code span suppresses the issue autolink: no cross-referenced event was produced for `#N`, while plain #N produced one. Mention-notification suppression was not testable with a single account.
facts.request: POST issue bodies containing `#N` in a code span and #N plain; GET /issues/{N}/timeline after each.

facts.finding: An issue ETag changes on a new comment and on a reaction (If-None-Match then returns 200, not 304); an untouched issue returns 304.
facts.request: GET issue, conditional GET, POST comment, conditional GET, POST reaction, conditional GET.

facts.finding: updated_at does not advance when a repository-level label rename changes what the issue shows.
facts.request: PATCH /repos/{r}/labels/renlab new_name, GET issue before and after.
facts.response: updated_at identical; the issue shows the new name.

facts.finding: No dependency limit was reached: 60 blocked_by relations on one issue were accepted. The true limit is above 60 or absent.

retry-after on content-creation secondary limits was not observed: 150 comment creations at about 70 per minute never tripped a limit, and deliberately exceeding 80 per minute was not attempted to avoid an integration ban. Keep F3 handling (retry-after, else reset, else 60 s backoff).

nudge_repository_dispatch.finding: POST /dispatches from a workflow GITHUB_TOKEN needs contents: write (204); contents: read and no permissions both get 403. The receiving workflow needs no permissions.
nudge_repository_dispatch.request: workflow_dispatch workflow with three jobs calling POST /repos/{r}/dispatches with permissions {}, contents:read, contents:write.
nudge_repository_dispatch.response: none 403, read 403, write 204; PAT also 204; the repository_dispatch run succeeded.
